Introduction to Chemistry

Chemistry is the study of matter, its properties, and the changes it can undergo. Everything around us is made of matter, from the air we breathe to the materials used in everyday objects.

Start with the basics below and build a foundation for understanding how substances interact.

Atoms Atoms are the basic units of matter. They contain a nucleus surrounded by electrons.
Elements An element is a pure substance made from one type of atom. The periodic table organizes the known elements.
Molecules Molecules form when atoms join together. Their structures help determine the properties of a substance.
Reactions Chemical reactions rearrange atoms to form new substances with different properties.
States of Matter Solids, liquids, and gases behave differently because their particles have different arrangements and motion.
Acids and Bases Acids and bases have different chemical properties and can be compared using the pH scale.
